image_description: A vintage, antique-style cast iron smoothing iron (sad iron) resting on a neutral fabric background. The object features a heavy, blocky rectangular body with a distinct arched handle topped with a wooden grip. It has a lever mechanism on the side and decorative scalloped edges along the top rim of the base. The surface appears weathered, rusty, or made of rough cast metal, lacking the polished finish of modern irons.
